_doc: Standard client texts and the Finishing Touches file (assistant/scripts/client_texts.py). the owner's standing rule of 2026-10-17: the whole client process is texted from his iPhone (the owner-iphone) without a card; these are the exact words, in his voice. Edit the words here, never in code. Placeholders: {first} the client's first name, {couple} both first names, {email} the address the collection went to, {wedding_date} e.g. 'November 7', {what} the meeting kind, {when} e.g. 'tomorrow at 3:00 PM'. Each kind can be switched off in assistant/config.json -> texts.kinds. Nothing client-facing ever says 'add-ons' (the owner 2026-10-17: it has to sound upscale); the word is 'finishing touches'.

lead_intro.body:
Hello {first}! I just saw your wedding form come through on my phone! Could you just confirm your wedding date for me?

owner1 example 🌹

collection_sent.body: Hi {first}! I just sent our collection over to {email}. Let me know if you have any questions! {sign}

checkin._when: T-14 days before a booked wedding: sets up the check-in call
checkin.body: Hi {first}! {wedding_date} is two weeks away, so exciting! Let's set up a quick check-in call this week to go over your timeline and details. What day and time work best for you? {sign}

meeting_reminder.body: Hi {first}! Just a reminder that we have our {what} {when}. Looking forward to it! {sign}

touches_followup.body: Hi {first}! I just sent over a few finishing touches for {wedding_date}, in case any of them would be lovely for your day. No pressure at all, just let me know if anything catches your eye! {sign}

touches.subject: A few finishing touches for {wedding_date}
touches.body:
Hi {couple},

{wedding_date} is getting close, and I'm so excited for you two! As I start planning your coverage, I put together a few finishing touches that couples often ask us about in the final stretch. Your collection already covers everything we talked about, so none of these are needed; they're simply here so you know what's possible.

You can browse them at your own pace in the file below and add anything you'd love straight to your collection.

Either way, I can't wait for {wedding_date}!

owner1
example-org

toasts_speeches_film.name: Full Toasts & Speeches Film
toasts_speeches_film.why: Every toast and speech, start to finish, with clean audio, as its own film. Couples tell us this is the one they rewatch with family.

drone.name: Aerial Cinematography
drone.why: The sweeping shots of your venue and the two of you from above; it gives the film a true sense of place.

second_videographer.name: Second Cinematographer
second_videographer.why: A second set of eyes so we catch both of your reactions at the same time, and far less chance of missing a moment.

iphone_content_creator.name: iPhone Content Creator
iphone_content_creator.why: Someone dedicated to filming phone clips all day, so you have shareable moments the next morning instead of weeks later.

feature_film.name: Feature Film
feature_film.why: A longer 8 to 10 minute edit with room for the full arc of the day: more of the ceremony, the toasts and the people around you.

raw_footage.name: Raw Footage
raw_footage.why: Every clip from every camera, so nothing from the day is ever lost.

vows_reaction_angles.name: Vows Reaction Angles
vows_reaction_angles.why: A close-up on each of your faces during the vows. We want to see the teardrops.

signature_couples_shoot.name: Signature Couple's Session
signature_couples_shoot.why: A relaxed filmed date on another day, where we capture the two of you as you really are, not in front of a crowd.

touches._catalog_doc: price: a number here overrides the pricing sheet; null means use the sheet price for sheet_id. An item with no price from either place is left off the file. Toasts & speeches film $500 (set 2026-10-17 on the owner's 'you price them': between the capture-only touches at $300-$500 and the feature film at $1,000). The other touches follow the pricing sheet.

template_copy.Nice to meet you: Finishing Touches. {couple}, your day is almost here. Your collection already holds everything we planned together; these are the touches couples most often ask us about in the final stretch, here so you know what is possible. Choose anything you would love, or nothing at all.
template_copy.What to Expect: Each touch is added to your existing collection and due with your balance on the wedding day. Choose as many as you like on the next page, then review your updated investment at checkout. Questions? Reply to the email or text owner1 any time.
template_copy.Services: Choose anything you would love for your day.
template_copy.Next Steps: Once you add a touch, your collection is updated and owner1 confirms the plan with you before the wedding. Nothing changes unless you choose it.
